instruction: Create an empty disk image with default setting using Disk Utility. Place it at the default location under Documents. Name it as "Empty".
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Disk Utility" && echo "True" || echo "False"
